summary: Checked the TWILIO_ENABLED switch, the empty-catch lint fix and the Menu Stats ReferenceError fix. All 30 assertions in a new node test script pass (runs each mode in its own child process: unset, true, false). The requested checks all pass: syntax checks OK, zero empty catch blocks, the switch works in both directions, the Twilio search/buy guards work, the upgrade notes appear (EN only), the voice/bulk/canSearchBoth guards are in place, health returns 200, there are no new Node errors in the logs, and the HostPanel login reaches the dashboard. The repo's eslint (root eslint.config.js) still reports 478 errors (_index.js 432, voice-service.js 46), but none are no-empty. Within those, eslint found 2 real pre-existing runtime bugs (no-const-assign and no-undef 'name') that the main agent missed.

critical.issue: `const vpsDetails = info?.vpsDetails; if (!vpsDetails) vpsDetails = {}` throws TypeError 'Assignment to constant variable' whenever info.vpsDetails is missing (eslint no-const-assign). Fix: use `let`, or `const vpsDetails = info?.vpsDetails || {}`.

`const name` is declared inside the try (12964) but used in the catch (13004 adminUserTag(name, chatId)). When a purchase crashes, the catch handler itself throws ReferenceError and the admin crash alert is never sent (eslint no-undef 'name'). Fix: declare `let name` before the try, or re-fetch it inside the catch.

minor.issue: 478 lint errors remain: 408 no-unused-vars, 25 no-undef, 26 no-useless-assignment, 10 no-useless-escape, 5 no-misleading-character-class, plus 1 each of no-redeclare, no-constant-condition, no-irregular-whitespace, no-const-assign. 23 of the 25 no-undef are Node globals (URL, URLSearchParams, fetch) missing from the config's globals list; adding them (or `globals.node`) clears those false positives. The claim that lint is error-free holds only for no-empty.
The 'being upgraded' banner exists only in the EN translations. FR/ZH/HI users with leftover Twilio numbers get no notice when TWILIO_ENABLED=false (confirmed for fr).

action_items: Fix the const reassignment at js/_index.js:12409 (askVPSPlanAutoRenewal)
Fix the out-of-scope `name` in the domain-purchase catch at js/_index.js:13004
Optional: add Node globals (URL, URLSearchParams, fetch) to eslint.config.js and clean up no-unused-vars if the goal is a zero-error eslint run
Optional: add the being-upgraded banner to the fr/zh/hi myNumbersList/manageNumber translations
critical_code_review_comments: The switch is read in two separate copies of isTwilioEnabled (phone-config.js and twilio-service.js); they are identical. A single shared helper would be more DRY.
The catalog flags (allCountries/moreCountries) are computed at module load, so flipping the switch needs a restart. This is documented and intended.

success_rate.backend: 100% (30/30 requested assertions); 2 extra pre-existing runtime bugs found

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `node /app/js/tests/test_twilio_switch_2026-10.js` (spawns child processes per TWILIO_ENABLED mode, no network). For lint use `node_modules/.bin/eslint -f json js/_index.js js/voice-service.js` with the root eslint.config.js. Sandbox backend/.env has TWILIO_ENABLED=false.
rca of the issue: Both bugs come from block scoping: a const that is later reassigned (12409), and a try-block const used in its catch (13004). Both fail only on edge paths (missing vpsDetails, domain purchase exception), so normal flows never hit them.
